scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Full Auto Farm, Loot Farm, OP Skills+ More Autos
scripts.features:
This is a Luau automation script for Fishy, built on FishyUI, with RightShift toggling the menu. It gracefully uses common executor functions when available and falls back when they are not, while caching UI sources and lazily loading game modules with timeouts. The Farm tab handles auto farming, mob and region filters, target priority, attack positioning, auto quests, side quests, boss hunts, boss farming, and session status. Combat features include auto attack, faster attacks, kill aura, expanded hitboxes, auto skills, auto parry, auto weapon equipping, and limited ownership-based instant defeat and mob gathering. Loot features cover auto drops, chests, pickups, selling to a merchant, fishing, healing items, and retreat/recovery behavior. Visual features include ESP for mobs, bosses, players, NPCs, loot, and chests, plus lighting controls and performance options like low graphics, particle removal, texture hiding, and FPS caps. Travel and movement include tween or instant travel, shrine hops, saved spots, teleports to regions/NPCs/mobs/players, noclip, fly, infinite jump, and speed boost. Safety and management include anti-idle, no-pause, staff detection, auto rejoin/server hop, webhooks, session limits, breaks, theme/config saving, live labels, and a clean unload routine.

Project Slayers 2, Project Slayer 2, Project Slayer, Project Slayers, PS2
